title: Please list the chains of the gas stations with transactions in euro.
question: Please list the chains of the gas stations with transactions in euro.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT gs.ChainID
FROM GasStationTransactions gst
JOIN gasstations gs ON gst.GasStationID = gs.GasStationID
JOIN CustomerTransactions ct ON gst.TransactionID = ct.TransactionID
JOIN customers c ON ct.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
